svg.title: More boundaries become visible from the worker
svg.desc: Place successive node, cluster, network and source-control perimeters beyond the worker. Nested opportunity should not color every discovered boundary as already crossed. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
